title: The largest Meta data center yet brings big impact to Louisiana - Meta Data Centers
excerpts: In December 2024, Meta announced that we are building our largest data center to date in Richland Parish, Louisiana. The Richland Parish Data Center will be part of our global infrastructure that brings Meta technologies and programs to life, making the future of human connection possible. This data center will play a vital role in accelerating our AI progress, delivering 5 gigawatts of compute capacity to house Hyperion, our largest multi-gigawatt AI cluster.
**Skilled trade workers onsite at peak construction**

Meta is committed to being a good neighbor and community partner. More than $1.6 billion in contracts have gone to Louisiana businessessince construction began — keeping investment in-state and fueling small business growth. This year, teachers in Richland Parish received annual bonuses of up to $50,000 — 400% higher than last year — thanks to increased tax revenues from Meta’s data center project.

We take a full-lifecycle approach, focusing on reducing environmental impact from design and construction through operations and the responsible management of our equipment. Meta has been working closely with Entergy to plan for our energy needs, and we pay the full costs for the energy used by our data center, so consumers are not negatively impacted.

Once operational, this data center will support 1,000 operational jobs — electricians, HVAC specialists, server and network techs and engineers — to run the world’s most advanced data center. Check out current job openings with Mortenson, DPR Construction and Turner Construction Company, the three general contractors on the project.

The Richland Parish Data Center will play a vital role in accelerating our AI progress and enabling future generations of AI infrastructure. The data center will deliver over two gigawatts of compute capacity to train future open-source large language models — helping Meta unlock historic innovation and expand American technology leadership.
